journey.title: Top-down refinement from implementation
journey.purpose: Top-down refinement from implementation with explicit authority, provenance and evidence boundaries.

steps.intent: Inspect intended sectors and capability contribution with evidence limitations.
Inspect observed implementation evidence for the selected capability.
Propose a correction or decomposition based on bottom-up evidence.
Review the authored graph amendment separately from observed facts.

claims.statement: Given a mapped scenario, when capability coverage is reviewed, then contribution is not presented as verified fulfillment without applicable evidence.
claims.rationale: Documentation-first target; runtime bindings and evidence remain to be implemented and qualified.
